Since dueling in durotar is the only relevant content, i’m surprised there is still no addon that keeps track of your win/loses (just wins in my case) in duels

there were addons for that in vanilla (like SKMAP), but none works in classic

basically, kind of the same UI as pvp kills from Spy addon  
Something like:  
“duels vs asmongold:  
04/05/20 : win  
05/05/20 : win  
ratio: 100%”

any skilled indian can make it happen?
